integrity: Two separately written integer-only C++17 exhaustive classifiers were replayed from their attached source files, and their exact results agree; independence of scientific review is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Complete enumeration is for the 20-vertex labelled C4 Cartesian C5 graph only; not an all-size theorem. The preceding general eventual-period-two theorem and later structural characterization of periodic torus states are not claimed new. Historical priority is qualified; independent external review is not performed.
title: A five-step majority clock and 120 recurrent symmetry types on the \(4\times5\) torus
